statistic: fixed-target pooled slope of the expected-error excess of projection over single-scale ranking on log10 lever arm, points per decade; slices (target, rung count) with at least 3 windows; leave-one-recipe-out jackknife SE
targets: sizes at or above 150M with at least 5 sizes below (150M and 300M); a target is admitted when at least half its recipe pairs are determined by its own three-seed evidence

secondary.assumption: the predicted magnitude assumes the new recipes resemble DataDecide's 25 (drawn from the same distribution of power-law parameters and recipe-specific misfit); it is not part of the pass criterion
secondary.source: results/replication/protocol_dry_run.json: the corrected recipe model at multiplier 1 on the exact 6ND grid, 150 worlds

analysis_entry_point: scripts/analyze_replication.py (refuses to run if the pinned SHA-256 of the frozen modules differs)

within_regime_secondary.reason: PREDICTIONS_TASK_CONFIG_STEPS.md found that config steps do not contribute (outcome O1; step-term share interval includes zero), so the conditional secondary is not added; it would not be estimable on this ladder anyway (2 within-regime windows per target, below the 3-window slice rule)

evaluation_set.definition: DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file (sha256 c37d6b11...), 2,099 documents by id and text hash
evaluation_set.decontamination: two passes before tokenization (scripts/decontaminate.py): (1) exact: remove a training document whose SHA-256 of NFC-normalized text equals a sha256_nfc in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl; (2) 13-gram: remove a remaining training document that shares at least one 13-gram with any evaluation document, over text normalized by NFC, casefolding and replacing every non-letter, non-digit character with a space, then split on whitespace; 13-grams are matched by 64-bit blake2b hash against replication_protocol/eval_13grams.npz. Per corpus, the report gives the documents removed by each pass and the evaluation ids each pass hit

numerical_stability_diagnostic.inputs: every bpb value and each size's compute
numerical_stability_diagnostic.reported: slope min, max, SD, largest deviation from the reported slope, and the number of draws whose verdict differs
numerical_stability_diagnostic.role: output only; the verdict rule is unchanged and uses the unperturbed inputs

decontamination_sensitivity.trigger: a selected corpus loses more than 3% of its documents to the 13-gram decontamination pass, or more than twice the median 13-gram loss share across the ten selected corpora (loss share = removed_13gram / documents_in, from scripts/decontaminate.py's report)
decontamination_sensitivity.report: every triggering corpus is reported with its 13-gram loss share, the median, and the evaluation ids hit
decontamination_sensitivity.excluded_documents: for each triggering corpus, the smallest set of evaluation ids, taken in descending order of that corpus's 13-gram removal counts (ties broken by id), whose removals sum to more than half of the corpus's 13-gram removals
decontamination_sensitivity.sensitivity_analysis: the primary analysis (scripts/analyze_replication.py, unchanged) is rerun on every run's c4_en_bits_per_token recomputed on the evaluation set minus those documents, the same exclusion applied to all runs; one rerun per triggering corpus, plus one with the union of excluded documents if more than one corpus triggers
decontamination_sensitivity.logging_requirement: so that the rescore is possible, every run records its summed token loss and token count per evaluation document at the final checkpoint
decontamination_sensitivity.primary_verdict: unchanged: the primary verdict comes from the full evaluation set; the sensitivity results are reported beside it and do not replace it

logging_enforcement.evaluator_patch: replication_protocol/olmo_patch/olmo_per_document.patch (pinned; applies to allenai/OLMo@7094aab; adds a complete, deterministic c4_en evaluator), required by every run config
logging_enforcement.primary_metric: the primary c4_en_bits_per_token is built from the per-document logs over the full evaluation set (scripts/rescore_replication.py build, no exclusion), which refuses unless every evaluation token was scored exactly once; OLMo's own reported metric is not used
logging_enforcement.rescore: scripts/rescore_replication.py: final-step logs, chunks deduplicated across ranks, documents in the exclusion list dropped, bits per token recomputed; exclusions derives the v2.3 exclusion lists from decontamination reports
logging_enforcement.refusal: scripts/analyze_replication.py --sensitivity-exclude refuses to run if any run in the runs table lacks final-checkpoint per-document logs

primary_metric: c4_en_bits_per_token: summed next-token cross-entropy (nats) over every token of the 2,099 evaluation documents, each predicted exactly once by the complete deterministic evaluator (windows of 2048, stride 2047, over [EOS] + file), divided by the token count (1,021,899) and by ln 2, at the final checkpoint; computed from the per-document logs by scripts/rescore_replication.py build. OLMo's own reported metric is not used.
